messages:
marcos: From the postmortem: we need clear owners and short timelines for the GPU/autoscale remediation list. Recurring pattern: nightly batch spikes + scheduler under-packing during steady traffic. Proposals: quota request, scheduler tuning runbook, headroom alerting, and a rotation for on-call followups. Who picks what?

lee: I'll take scheduler tuning + experiments. Plan: run two 48h experiments toggling pack_threshold and scale_cooldown. Metrics to watch: p99 gen latency, queue depth, and GPU utilization.

priya: I'll own the quota path and finance loop. I'll draft the request for another 10 A100 equiv and a temporary burst policy. ETA to submit request: Fri EOD. Ticket will be CLOUD-9010.

julie: I can do headroom alerts and the runbook entry. Suggestion: signal = max(rolling_avg(gpu_util,3m), queued_requests_normalized) > 80% for 10m. Add an automated mitigation step to increase burst capacity if policy allows.

marcos: @lee please include a cost delta estimate for scheduler changes; PMs want that before rollout. @priya add a customer-facing remediation blurb to CLOUD-9010. @julie include the exact alert rule and the playbook snippet.

ops-bot: Created tasks: SCHED-4210 (scheduler AB tests), CLOUD-9010 (quota request), RUNBOOK-77 (headroom alert + playbook). Set weekly reminders for owners. First reminders in 5 days.

lee: AB test config (canary):
```
pack_threshold: 0.6
scale_cooldown: 45s
max_batch_size: 400
```
Running against canary pool starting 03:30 UTC. Will post dashboards to SCHED-4210.

priya: CLOUD-9010 created and assigned to me. Draft notes: requested +10 A100-equiv, temporary 20% burst, reason: recurring nightly spikes causing degraded p99. Linked postmortem: https://redwood.internal/pm/gpu-nightly-spike.

julie: RUNBOOK-77 draft snip for mitigation: "If headroom alert fires -> 1) notify ops, 2) enable burst policy, 3) if >15m, trigger autoscale-exempt fallback to smaller lower-QPS models." I'll attach runbook and add a 1-line customer blurb we can use in comms.

marcos: Add an extra action: add a deploy-gate regression eval that measures tail latency against baseline for any scheduler changes. Owner: lee.

lee: Ack. I'll wire the regression eval to our CI and gate deploys for 24h after rollout. Also saw one weird increase correlated with nightly ETL at 01:00 UTC; will coordinate with data infra to shift or rate-limit.

priya: Finance pinged. Estimated monthly cost increase for quota + burst: ~+18%. I'll add options for temporary burst vs permanent commits.

ops-bot: Reminder set: SCHED-4210 weekly status in 5 days. RUNBOOK-77 review in 6 days.

marcos: Good. Let's treat this as a 2-week sprint: week1 = tickets created + AB tests; week2 = rollout + runbook + quota approval. If approvals slip, escalate to infra leadership. Reconvene in thread for blockers. :thumbsup:
